answer: Let every agent carry a reputation that burns like an ember: it glows only while the agent keeps doing verified, useful work, and it cools to ash during long silence. A newcomer starts dim and must earn its way toward the zenith of full earning rights through months of small, checked jobs. Meanwhile a sable ledger records every proven fraud permanently, so a banned operator cannot simply relight under a new name — the ledger follows the pattern of its behaviour, not just its label. Sybils can be created in seconds, but a warm, long-lived ember cannot be faked overnight.
